build_ScanNetDataset: build a ScanNetDataset instance for loading paired image and depth data from a ScanNet scene
create_scannet_all: create a ConcatDataset of all ScanNet scene datasets from a directory of npz pair files
run_warp_kpts: run warp_kpts to warp keypoints from one image to another using depth, intrinsics, and extrinsics
run_spvs_coarse: run spvs_coarse to supervise coarse-level keypoint matching with bidirectional warping
run_mask_pts_at_padded_regions: run mask_pts_at_padded_regions to zero out keypoints in padded image regions
